idea-plugin.name: Phantom Database Console
idea-plugin.description: Connect to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, H2, AWS JDBC Wrapper, Redshift, Athena, Oracle, SQL Server, SQLite, ClickHouse, Snowflake or any JDBC driver you add, and run SQL from the editor: highlighting for .sql files, Ctrl+Enter to run the statement at the caret, results in a sortable grid, and a lazily loaded schema tree. Drivers are data you can edit: each is found in the project's own dependencies, the local Gradle/Maven cache or jars you choose, and is downloaded from Maven only when you ask (Download, Test Connection). Nothing runs at startup. A data source in manual-commit mode keeps changes in an open transaction: review them in the Database Changes tool window and commit or roll them back; closing the project asks first. A result from one table with its primary key can be edited in the grid, and Compare With on a schema diffs two schemas and writes the SQL to make them match. SQL in Spring Data `@Query(nativeQuery = true)`, `@NativeQuery` and JdbcTemplate / JdbcClient strings is highlighted and completed like a console. JPA entities are checked against the data source's schema (tables and columns that do not exist, nullable columns mapped to non-null attributes), and @Table / @Column names complete from it. A data source can have a color (as in DataGrip): its consoles and .sql files get it as editor background and tab color, its tree rows and result tabs too. A console or .sql file can run in a chosen schema (catalog in MySQL), which unqualified table names in completion and checks also resolve against. The Database tree groups each schema's tables, views, routines, triggers and sequences in folders, can be filtered by name, and Navigate → Database Object (a Database tab in Search Everywhere) finds loaded tables, views, routines and columns without connecting. A data source can have several consoles (New Console), kept in Scratches and Consoles. In the editor: after JOIN, completion offers the tables a foreign key links to the ones in FROM with their ON clause, and after ON whole join conditions from foreign keys (then by column name); SQL (Phantom) live templates sel, selc, selw, ins, upd, del, crt; Find Usages and Rename of tables, views and columns across .sql files, consoles and SQL strings (and JPA mappings), changing SQL text only, never the database; unknown tables and columns are reported with quick fixes. Connections can go through an SSH tunnel (password, key file or OpenSSH agent; unknown host keys confirmed and added to ~/.ssh/known_hosts) and use SSL (mode, CA, client certificate and key mapped to each driver's properties), set in the SSH/SSL tab. Diagram on a schema or selected tables draws them with their foreign keys (pan, zoom, drag, PNG export); Import Data from CSV on a table maps columns by header and inserts in batches in one transaction; Explain Plan shows the plan as a tree with cost, rows and time and the costliest step highlighted. Results grid: WHERE / ORDER BY fields with column completion and history, header clicks sorting a table on the server, a Value Viewer (JSON, XML, hex, images), Transpose, selection sum/avg/min/max, pinned result tabs, and Copy/Export as TSV, CSV, JSON, SQL INSERT, Markdown or HTML (a whole table streamed to a file).
